description: This file defines functions and constants related to default time domain allocations for PDSCH in 5G NR, including tables for different configurations and functions to retrieve appropriate allocations based on search space and RNTI types.

methods.name: s_and_len
methods.description: Helper function to construct ofdm_symbol_range with start and length.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Retrieves default PDSCH time domain allocation for given cyclic prefix, row index, and DMRS position.

methods.name: pdsch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Returns a table of default PDSCH time domain allocations based on cyclic prefix and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets the PDSCH time domain list for a given search space configuration and BWP, based on RNTI type.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets the PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI, based on cyclic prefix and DMRS position.

methods.name: get_si_rnti_type0A_common_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets the PDSCH time domain list for SI-RNTI Type0A common, based on common PDSCH config.

methods.name: get_ra_rnti_pdsch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Gets the PDSCH time domain list for RA-RNTI, based on common PDSCH config.
